card.title: Tell Me Why
card.instruction: Get someone to reveal the motive behind a choice by offering small pieces of your own truth as bait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're circling the station. I avoid my old office too. Why this route?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My former boss catches this train.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I told mine I'd become a novelist. What did you tell yours?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That I had a better offer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've carried the same blank notebook past mine for a year. Are you avoiding him because there wasn't a better offer?

mechanism: A trades small admissions about a false career story for B's explanation of avoiding a former boss.
confusable: Unlike sympathetic swapping of failures, A must use each disclosure to ask a more revealing motive question.
comparison: Professional embarrassment and a route detour differ from the invitation scene's jealousy and emotional preference.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
